prompt: Write a haiku about a lighthouse.

sampler.note: original MDLM random unmasking order, same block schedule

answer:
The lighthouse shines bright,
In the darkness of the night,
As a beacon that guides the way.

It shines bright through the dark night,
In the darkness of the night,
As a beacon that guides the way.

So, the lighthouse shines bright,
In the darkness of the night,
As a beacon that guides the way.

So, the lighthouse shines bright,
In the light,
In the darkness of the night,
As a beacon that guides the way.

It shines bright through the dark night,
In the darkness of the night,
As a beacon that guides the way.
